build_ConformerEncoderLayer: build a ConformerEncoderLayer module with feed-forward, multi-head attention, and convolution blocks for audio processing
create_ConformerEncoder: create a ConformerEncoder transformer with streaming mask support, relative attention bias, and chunked sequence handling for long audio
create_WindowQformer: create a WindowQformer that reduces audio token sequences using transformer decoder layers over sliding windows
create_AudioEmbedding: create an AudioEmbedding module that encodes audio features through a Conformer encoder, optional Qformer, and projection to hidden dimensions
run_AudioEmbedding_forward: run the AudioEmbedding forward pass to convert raw audio features into hidden-dimension embeddings for multimodal models
